indication: To control blood glucose levels after meals
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: 15 minutes prior eating or right after a meal
mechanism_of_action: Helps some tissues in your body to preserve glucose in their cells; prevents the liver from releasing more glucose; hinders the breakdown of proteins and fats; helps to control the overall production as well as breakdown of sugar in your body
side_effects: tender swollen glands on the neck || itching, swelling, redness at the injected area
